title: Treasury Basis — What a Level Plan Is Taken to Have Collected Over the Year
content:
What a level plan on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts is taken to have collected over the plan year depends on how the money actually reached the cooperative: by the standing monthly draft authorised under the plan, by bank transfer, or by neither.

**Where the plan's drafts were taken in at least 10 months over the plan year and no payment posted on the account reached the cooperative by bank transfer in that year**, the plan's collection is the money the drafts actually took.

**Where the plan's drafts were taken in fewer than 10 months over the plan year and at least one payment posted on the account reached the cooperative by bank transfer in that year**, the plan's collection is the money the drafts actually took together with those bank transfers, the sum of the two taken to two decimal places.

**Where the drafts were taken in at least 10 months and at least one payment posted on the account reached the cooperative by bank transfer, and equally where the drafts were taken in fewer months than 10 and no payment posted on the account reached the cooperative by bank transfer**, the plan's collection is the instalments billed over the plan year.

## The four combinations

| Months in which a plan draft was taken | Any payment posted on the account by bank transfer in the year | The plan's collection |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 or more | None | The money the drafts actually took |
| 10 or more | At least one | The instalments billed over the plan year |
| Fewer than 10 | At least one | The money the drafts took, together with those bank transfers |
| Fewer than 10 | None | The instalments billed over the plan year |

The bank transfers that count are payments posted on the account; money committed elsewhere on the account is not one of them. The money figures are taken as positive sums however the entries stand on the account, and the count of drafts is a count of the months in which a draft was taken, not of the money it took.

*Hypothetical.* Over a plan year a member's drafts were taken in 11 months, coming to 3850.00 USD, and no payment posted on the account reached the cooperative by bank transfer. The plan's collection is 3850.00 USD. Had a single bank transfer of 400.00 USD also been posted on the account in that year, the collection would instead be the instalments billed over the plan year. Had the drafts been taken in only 8 months, coming to 2800.00 USD, with that same 400.00 USD transfer posted, the collection would be 3200.00 USD.
